why: Variant 1 is the only script that commits to a true one-way descent — no jokes, no 'ow' bits, no late-night monologuing to re-spike the listener — and it drops the quotable clean, isolated, tagged [slowly], at the exact pivot into the sink, then echoes it near the bottom where it lands like a lullaby refrain instead of a punchline (V2 buries it under banter, V3 spends it too early and then undercuts it with 'say it back if you want').
fixes: Trim the terminal loop by roughly one full cycle — the 'Rain… Heart… Warm' rotation repeats once too many; end on the second 'Just rain' echo and the final 'shhh… rain' fade so the outro drifts instead of plateaus.
Soften 'Good girl. Good.' to just 'Good. That's it.' — the sudden intensity of the pet phrase mid-descent is a micro-spike right when the breathing sync is taking hold.
